title: Among players with a potential score of 61, find the name of the tallest on
question: Among players with a potential score of 61, find the name of the tallest one whose overall rating is above the average overall rating of all players with potential 61.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t1."XCL_123"
FROM Player AS t1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1."XCL_122" = t2."XCL_130"
WHERE t2."XCL_133" = 61
  AND t2."XCL_132" > (SELECT AVG(t2_sub."XCL_132") FROM Player_Attributes AS t2_sub WHERE t2_sub."XCL_133" = 61)
ORDER BY t1."XCL_126" DESC
LIMIT 1
